[[File:Delbert.png|250px|thumb|Delbert]] '''Delbert''' (Japanese: '''ドモン''' ''Domon'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. He first appeared in ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]'', where he was a participant of the [[Clubsplosion]] tournament. Delbert's first opponent was [[Montgomery]], who he battled in ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]''. Though Delbert started out confident during the match and made the first move, he was taken aback by Montgomery's {{p|Throh}}'s evasive techniques and heavy-handed approach. The quick match ended with Delbert's loss. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Delbert |width=68 |pkmn=Mienshao |img=Delbert Mienshao.png |type1=Fighting |epnum=BW071 |epname=Search for the Clubultimate! |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc=Delbert used {{p|Mienshao}} in the first round of the Clubsplosion tournament and its opponent was Montgomery's {{p|Throh}}. Each of its attacks were evaded by the Judo Pokémon who then caused heavy damage to it with {{m|Seismic Toss}}. Mienshao was defeated after Throh used {{m|Circle Throw}} on it which sent it crashing into a wall. Later on, it was revealed that {{an|Bianca}} was busy feeling Mienshao's muscles, which was the reason why she was late for her own battle.
